note: Fight cards for the people the party is most likely to fight or fight beside (GM only): 2024-format stat blocks built from each person's species, class and subclass in the NPC builds, with how they fight. Owner decision, November 2026.

NPC-005.name: Captain Marrek Vaal

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If Marrek moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and hits it with Lance on the same turn, it takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Marrek makes two Lance attacks and one Hoof attack, or two Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Lance
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hoof
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Psionic Strike (2/Day)
bonus.text: After hitting with a weapon, Marrek deals an extra 7 (2d6) Force damage to the target.

reactions.name: Protective Field
reactions.text: Trigger: Marrek or an ally within 30 feet takes damage. Response: Reduce the damage by 7 (1d6 + 4).

NPC-005.tactics: Offers terms first, every time. Charges the strongest-looking foe, then pulls back to the bow. Accepts surrender at once, and keeps his word about it.

NPC-008.name: Vess the Grey

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: It deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage when it hits with an attack roll and has Advantage, or when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Hungry Jaws
traits.text: Once per Short Rest, when Vess hits with Bite, it gains 5 Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Vess makes two attacks: Shortsword and Bite, or two Hand Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
bonus.text: Vess takes the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.

NPC-008.skills: Deception +3, Insight +3, Perception +5, Sleight of Hand +7, Stealth +7
NPC-008.tactics: Never fights fair or long. Has an exit planned before the party arrives, and a second Vess (another member sharing the identity) watching from somewhere.

NPC-009.name: Mother Thorn

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Mother Thorn makes two Thorn Staff attacks, or uses Starry Arrow twice.

actions.name: Thorn Staff
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Starry Arrow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: She casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom (spell save DC 13): At will: Druidcraft, Guidance. 2/day each: Entangle, Healing Word (2d4 + 3), Moonbeam. 1/day: Plant Growth.

bonus.name: Hidden Step (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
bonus.text: She has the Invisible condition until the start of her next turn, or until she attacks or casts a spell.

NPC-009.tactics: Would rather end a fight than win it. Turns invisible and leads attackers astray in Wither's Hollow, then sends the wolves.

NPC-011.name: Torren Kell

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: It deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits with an attack roll and has Advantage, or when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.text: Torren ignores Difficult Terrain made of earth or stone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Torren makes two Crowbar attacks.

actions.name: Crowbar
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
bonus.text: Torren takes the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.

NPC-011.skills: Investigation +3, Perception +2, Sleight of Hand +4, Stealth +4
NPC-011.tactics: Fights only for salvage or to get his crew out. Will sell anyone out for a better offer, except his crew.

NPC-012.name: Sera Noll

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: It deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits with an attack roll and has Advantage, or when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Rabbit Hop
traits.text: Sera can jump 15 feet as a Bonus Action without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Sera makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Sera casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence (spell save DC 12): At will: Mage Hand (invisible), Minor Illusion. 2/day each: Disguise Self, Sleep. 1/day: Invisibility.

NPC-012.tactics: Watches, never strikes first. Uses illusions to get away and Mage Hand to take one thing on the way out: usually a letter or a journal.

NPC-017.name: Inquisitor Malrik Vael

traits.name: Umbral Sight
traits.text: While in darkness, Malrik has the Invisible condition to creatures that rely on Darkvision to see him.

traits.name: Dread Ambush
traits.text: On his first turn of a combat, Malrik's Speed increases by 10 feet and he can make one extra Crossbow or Rapier attack that deals an extra 9 (2d8) Psychic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Malrik makes two Rapier or Hand Crossbow attacks, and can replace one with Brand of Silence (see Celestial Inquisitor [CRE-003], DC 14).

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

NPC-017.tactics: Arrives already knowing who's guilty. Strikes from darkness at the first round, brands spellcasters, and walks away if outmatched: he always comes back better prepared.

NPC-018.name: Knight-Commander Edric Thalmos

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.text: If Edric moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and hits it with Horns on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition if Large or smaller.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Edric makes three Greataxe attacks, or two Greataxe and one Horns.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Horns
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Battle Command (3/Day)
bonus.text: One ally within 30 feet makes one weapon attack as a Reaction, adding 1d8 to the damage.

NPC-018.tactics: Leads from the front. Fights the Legion harder than anyone, and hesitates, just once, before striking an old comrade.

NPC-021.name: Seraphis the Ascended

traits.name: Vow of Enmity
traits.text: At the start of combat, Seraphis chooses one creature. It has Advantage on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute.

traits.name: Constructed Resilience
traits.text: Seraphis doesn't need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Seraphis makes three Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

bonus.name: Relentless Avenger
bonus.text: After hitting with an Opportunity Attack, Seraphis moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

NPC-021.gear: White plate that never ages, Greatsword
NPC-021.tactics: Silent. Chooses one target, the condemned, and pursues it through everything else. Doesn't stop until the sentence is carried out, or it is destroyed.

NPC-024.name: Warlord Garron Kael

traits.name: Rage (3/Day)
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, Garron rages for 1 minute: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and +3 damage on Strength-based attacks (included).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.text: If Garron fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Fortune of the Many
traits.text: Once per turn, when Garron misses, he gains +1 to the roll for each ally he can see within 30 feet (max +5).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Garron makes three Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage while raging, or 20 (4d6 + 6) otherwise.

bonus.name: Frenzy
bonus.text: While raging, Garron makes one extra Greatsword attack.

legendary.name: Uses
legendary.text: 2, regained at the start of his turn. Immediately after another creature's turn, he can expend a use to take one of the following actions.

legendary.name: Warlord's Bellow
legendary.text: Each ally within 60 feet that can hear him gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

NPC-024.tactics: Fights in the open, where his Legion can see him win. Rages, then Frenzies. He never retreats, but his centurions will drag him out if he falls.

NPC-026.name: Champion Valrik the Undying

traits.name: Stone Skin
traits.text: Valrik's AC includes his skin of stone. He can't be knocked Prone while standing on earth or stone.

traits.name: Rage of the Zealot (3/Day)
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, Valrik rages for 1 minute; while raging, the first creature he hits each turn takes an extra 5 (1d6 + 2) Radiant damage.

traits.name: Undying (1/Day)
traits.text: When Valrik drops to 0 Hit Points while raging, he drops to 1 instead and his rage continues.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Valrik makes three Maul attacks.

actions.name: Maul
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

NPC-026.tactics: Plays to the crowd. Takes the first hit on purpose so they see it bounce off. Has never been seen to fall, and has a plan in place to make sure nobody sees it.

NPC-027.name: Korga Bloodfang

traits.name: Relentless Endurance (1/Long Rest)
traits.text: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, Korga drops to 1 instead.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.text: Korga's weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Korga makes three Greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 20/60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Adrenaline Rush
bonus.text: Korga moves up to her Speed toward an enemy and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

NPC-027.tactics: A pit-fighter still. Feints, laughs, and goes for the throat of whoever looks most like a champion. Doesn't stop at 0 Hit Points the first time.

NPC-028.name: Lyris Darkbane

traits.name: Halo of Spores
traits.text: Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Lyris takes 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Lyris makes two Rot Touch attacks, or uses Raise the Fallen and makes one Rot Touch.

actions.name: Rot Touch
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Raise the Fallen (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Up to four corpses of Medium or Small creatures within 30 feet rise as spore servants (use Zombie) under Lyris's command until it dies.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Lyris casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom (spell save DC 14): At will: Chill Touch (2d10). 2/day each: Blight, Cloudkill.

NPC-028.tactics: Raises the dead before anything else, then fights from behind them. Treats the battle as a garden. Its dead fall apart into spores when it leaves.

NPC-029.name: Tormek Ironheart

traits.name: Impenetrable
traits.text: Critical hits against Tormek are normal hits. He has Resistance to Slashing and Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Tormek makes two Thunder Gauntlet attacks.

actions.name: Thunder Gauntlet
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Thunder damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but Tormek until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Launcher
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 90/300 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Lightning damage.

reactions.name: Defensive Field
reactions.text: Trigger: Tormek is Bloodied at the start of his turn. Response: He gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

NPC-029.gear: Armour he built himself (no blade has pierced it)
NPC-029.tactics: Steps in front of his allies and dares anyone to hit him. Pulls the most dangerous enemy to him with Thunder Gauntlets, then holds the line.

NPC-030.name: Riven the Red

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.text: Riven has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in the combat, and any hit against a Surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: It deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when it hits with an attack roll and has Advantage, or when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Riven has Advantage on saving throws against spells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Riven makes two Headsman's Blade attacks.

actions.name: Headsman's Blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
bonus.text: Riven takes the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.

NPC-030.tactics: Smiles all the way in. Strikes before anyone has acted, at whoever is wearing a crown or giving orders. Leaves if the first blow doesn't kill.

NPC-032.name: Balar the Unchained

traits.name: Unarmoured
traits.text: Balar's AC includes his Constitution.

traits.name: Rage of the Beast (3/Day)
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, Balar rages for 1 minute: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and he grows claws and a bite.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance (1/Short Rest)
traits.text: When Balar takes damage, he reduces it by 1d12 + 5.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Balar makes two Chain attacks, or while raging, two Claw attacks and one Bite.

actions.name: Chain
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and Balar gains 5 Temporary Hit Points.

NPC-032.gear: Broken chains, still on his wrists
NPC-032.tactics: Charges whoever looks like an owner of slaves. Can be talked out of a fight by anyone who frees someone in front of him.

NPC-045.name: Selene Duskveil

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.text: Selene has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in the combat, and any hit against a Surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: It deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when it hits with an attack roll and has Advantage, or when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Feline Agility (Recharges when she ends a turn without moving)
traits.text: Selene doubles her Speed until the end of the turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Selene makes three Claw-blade attacks.

actions.name: Claw-blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
bonus.text: Selene takes the Dash, Disengage or Hide action.

NPC-045.tactics: No target has ever survived her because she never fights a fair round: she waits for the perfect moment, takes it, and is gone before the second.

NPC-048.name: Cazrin "the Hollow Blade"

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.text: It deals an extra 17 (5d6) damage when it hits with an attack roll and has Advantage, or when an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

traits.name: Psychic Blades
traits.text: Cazrin's blades are made of his own mind. He is never disarmed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Cazrin makes two Psychic Blade attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Blade
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Hollow Step
bonus.text: Cazrin teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

NPC-048.tactics: Fights without anger, because the Pact took that too. Asks each opponent if they knew him before. If one says yes, he stops.

NPC-052.name: Elira Nightshade

traits.name: Silent Daggers
traits.text: A creature hit by Elira's daggers can't speak until the start of her next turn, so it can't cast spells with a Verbal component.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Elira makes three attacks: Dagger or Unarmed Strike in any combination.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadow Arts
actions.text: Elira casts Darkness or Silence, using Wisdom (spell save DC 14), without spending components.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
bonus.text: While in dim light or darkness, Elira teleports up to 60 feet to another space in dim light or darkness, and has Advantage on her next attack this turn.

NPC-052.tactics: Kills sound first: the room goes silent, and then she moves. Hunts other assassins for the joy of it.

NPC-055.name: Korrak Grimtusk

traits.name: Colossus Slayer
traits.text: Once per turn, when Korrak hits a creature that is missing any Hit Points, it takes an extra 4 (1d8) damage.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance (1/Long Rest)
traits.text: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, Korrak drops to 1 instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Korrak makes three attacks, using Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Hunter's Mark
bonus.text: Korrak marks a creature she can see; her attacks against it deal an extra 3 (1d6) Force damage for 1 hour.

NPC-055.tactics: Hunts alone, so she never fights where she can be surrounded. Kills the leader of a warband, then lets the rest run home and tell it.

NPC-058.name: Sareth "the Serpent"

traits.name: Umbral Sight
traits.text: In darkness Sareth has the Invisible condition to creatures that rely on Darkvision to see him.

traits.name: Dread Ambush
traits.text: On his first turn of a combat, Sareth's Speed increases by 10 feet and he makes one extra attack dealing an extra 9 (2d8) Psychic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Sareth makes two attacks, using Serpent Blade or Blowgun in any combination.

actions.name: Serpent Blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Blowgun
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 25/100 ft. Hit: 6 (1d2 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
bonus.text: Sareth teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.

NPC-058.tactics: You will not see him coming: he strikes from the canopy on the first round, then is somewhere else entirely.

NPC-061.name: Jorik Fangtorn

traits.name: Dreadful Strikes
traits.text: Once per turn, Jorik's weapon hit deals an extra 4 (1d8) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Otherworldly Glamour
traits.text: Jorik adds his Wisdom to Charisma checks (included in his manner, if not his statistics).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Jorik makes two Longbow or Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Beguiling Twist
reactions.text: Trigger: Jorik or a creature within 120 feet succeeds on a save against being Charmed or Frightened. Response: A different creature within 120 feet makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or has that condition for 1 minute.

NPC-061.tactics: Leaves no tracks, and fights the same way: never seen where he was a moment ago. Spares anyone who shows respect to the forest.

NPC-069.name: Titan-King Varuun

traits.name: Rage of the Zealot
traits.text: Varuun is always raging: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and the first creature he hits each turn takes an extra 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If Varuun fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rift-Grown
traits.text: Varuun is far bigger than any living goliath. He can grapple Huge creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Varuun makes three Titan Hammer attacks.

actions.name: Titan Hammer
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition if it's Large or smaller.

actions.name: Hurl Boulder
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) Bludgeoning damage.

legendary.name: Uses
legendary.text: 2, regained at the start of his turn. Immediately after another creature's turn, he can expend a use to take one of the following actions.

legendary.name: Hammer
legendary.text: He makes one Titan Hammer attack.

legendary.name: Stomp
legendary.text: Each creature within 10 feet makes a DC 20 Dexterity save or has the Prone condition.

NPC-069.tactics: Rules by being the strongest, so he fights in the open and alone. Respects anyone who lands a real blow, and offers a place among the Titans to whoever survives.

NPC-071.name: Magistrate Althros

traits.name: Psychic Defense
traits.text: Althros's AC includes his Wisdom.

traits.name: Mental Fortress
traits.text: Althros has Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened, and can't have his thoughts read.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Althros makes four Unarmed Strike attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Psychic damage. Open Hand: the target makes a DC 17 Strength save or is pushed 15 feet or knocked Prone (Althros's choice).

actions.name: Judgement (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature that has broken the realm's law within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

NPC-071.tactics: Fights only to restrain, and only after stating the law that was broken. Ends a fight the moment the lawbreaker submits.

NPC-073.name: Selka "the Pactmother"

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Selka has Advantage on saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Knows Every Betrayal
traits.text: Selka can't be Surprised, and has Advantage on Initiative.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Selka uses Mind Lash twice.

actions.name: Mind Lash
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Selka casts one of the following spells, using Charisma (spell save DC 18): At will: Detect Thoughts, Suggestion. 2/day each: Dominate Person, Hypnotic Pattern. 1/day: Mass Suggestion.

reactions.name: Call in a Debt
reactions.text: Trigger: A creature that owes the Company anything attacks Selka. Response: It makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or the attack misses and it can't attack her until the end of its next turn.

NPC-073.languages: Common, Abyssal, Deep Speech, telepathy 60 ft.
NPC-073.tactics: Never in the room where the fighting is, if she can help it. If cornered, she reminds each enemy of their debts to the Bloodbound Company, by name.

NPC-080.name: Aedrin "the Cinderfather"

traits.name: Burning Forever
traits.text: Aedrin is always on fire. A creature that touches him or hits him with a melee attack within 5 feet takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Cursed to Live
traits.text: When Aedrin drops to 0 Hit Points, he is reduced to ash and reforms 1d10 days later in the ruin of his capital, unless the curse is broken.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Aedrin uses Searing Ray three times.

actions.name: Searing Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Fire damage.

actions.name: Pyre (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. Failure: 45 (10d8) Fire damage, and its flammable gear catches fire. Success: Half damage only.

bonus.name: Celestial Flame (1/Day)
bonus.text: Aedrin regains 25 (5d8 + 3) Hit Points, and each creature of his choice within 10 feet takes 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

NPC-080.tactics: Burns everything, including his own followers, and weeps while he does it. Can't die by fire. Begs any who reach him to end the curse, then fights them anyway.

NPC-083.name: Seraine "the Eclipse Blade"

traits.name: Eclipse Blade
traits.text: Seraine's sword sheds magical darkness in a 15-foot radius when she chooses. She can see through it; nobody else can.

traits.name: Vow of Enmity
traits.text: At the start of combat, Seraine chooses one creature; she has Advantage on attack rolls against it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Seraine makes three Eclipse Blade attacks.

actions.name: Eclipse Blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Githyanki Step
bonus.text: Seraine teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

NPC-083.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. (sees through magical darkness), Passive Perception 12
NPC-083.gear: Plate Armor, a sword of darkness
NPC-083.tactics: Wears the eclipse. Brings darkness down in the first round, fights inside it where she alone can see, and chooses the brightest-armoured foe.

NPC-085.name: Cassiel "the False Dawn"

traits.name: Fallen Wings
traits.text: While Bloodied, Cassiel gains a Fly Speed of 30 feet and her Dark Ray deals an extra 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Cassiel makes two Mace attacks and uses Dark Ray, or uses Dark Ray three times.

actions.name: Mace
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dark Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Whispers of the False Dawn (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature of her choice within 30 feet. Failure: 27 (6d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

NPC-085.tactics: Preaches through the whole fight. Targets Order knights and clerics first, to prove the gods don't answer. Unfolds wings of black light when Bloodied.

NPC-087.name: Father Iskar "the Tidecaller"

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Iskar can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Drowned Once
traits.text: Iskar can't drown, and has Advantage on saves against being Grappled or Restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Iskar makes two Tentacle Lash attacks, or uses Call the Drowned and makes one Tentacle Lash.

actions.name: Tentacle Lash
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward Iskar.

actions.name: Call the Drowned (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Two Drowned Saints [CRE-032] rise from water within 60 feet and act on Iskar's turn. They sink back into the water after 1 minute.

actions.name: Tidal Wave (1/Day)
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot line. Failure: 33 (6d10) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet and knocked Prone. Success: Half damage only.

NPC-087.tactics: Fights with the sea at his back, or brings it with him. Calls up the drowned and lets them do the work while he preaches.

NPC-095.name: Justicar Quell

traits.name: Watcher's Will
traits.text: Quell and allies within 30 feet have Advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened.

traits.name: Verdict
traits.text: Before combat Quell names one creature as guilty. Quell's attacks against it deal an extra 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Quell makes three Silver Sword attacks.

actions.name: Silver Sword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Abjure the Extraplanar (1/Day)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute and must move away from Quell.

NPC-095.languages: Common, Sylvan, and the hidden laws
NPC-095.tactics: The verdict comes before the words: Quell strikes the condemned first, then explains why. Leaves the innocent alone, even if they attack.

NPC-310.name: Maro Grane

traits.name: Glyph-Cut
traits.text: Maro's runes are cut from shoulder to wrist. He has Advantage on saving throws against being moved or knocked Prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Maro makes three Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Force damage.

bonus.name: Giant's Might (2/Day)
bonus.text: For 1 minute, Maro becomes Large, his reach becomes 10 feet, and his Greatsword deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage.

bonus.name: Storm Rune (1/Day)
bonus.text: For 1 minute, Maro can use his Reaction to give a creature within 60 feet Advantage or Disadvantage on one roll.

NPC-310.gear: Glyph-cut armour, Greatsword, the Riftwalker's rope
NPC-310.tactics: Fights for the Collective's cycles, never for himself. Uses his runes to grow and shove enemies off ledges. Stops if anyone mentions what the Rift took from him.

NPC-338.name: Scout-Captain Teague Dunmarsh

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.text: Teague ignores Difficult Terrain in the mountains and is unaffected by cold and high altitude.

traits.name: Colossus Slayer
traits.text: Once per turn, when Teague hits a creature missing any Hit Points, it takes an extra 4 (1d8) damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Teague makes two attacks, using Surveyor's Spear or Longbow.

actions.name: Surveyor's Spear
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Stone's Endurance (1/Short Rest)
reactions.text: Trigger: Teague takes damage. Response: He reduces it by 9 (1d12 + 3).

NPC-338.tactics: Counts his paces, even in a fight. Fights from high ground with a bow, and falls back to the mountain paths he has mapped and his enemies haven't.

NPC-372.name: Tessk the Wayfinder

traits.name: Knows the Paths
traits.text: In the Hollow Verge, Tessk and anyone she guides can't become lost, and ignore Difficult Terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Tessk makes three Unarmed Strike attacks, or two Silver Blade attacks.

actions.name: Silver Blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
bonus.text: In dim light or darkness, Tessk teleports up to 60 feet to another space in dim light or darkness.

NPC-372.tactics: Guides first, fights second. In a fight she uses the Verge itself, stepping through shadow to lead attackers onto paths that go nowhere.

NPC-380.name: Magister Ilse Varnholt

traits.name: Prosecutor
traits.text: Ilse has Advantage on Charisma checks against anyone who fears Kaelholm's tribunals.

traits.name: Unmasked
traits.text: Once her secret is out, Ilse can use A Teacher's Name, as an Eclipse-Touched.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Ilse uses Eclipse Ray twice.

actions.name: Eclipse Ray
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: Ilse casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence (spell save DC 15): At will: Message, Minor Illusion. 2/day each: Hold Person, Suggestion. 1/day: Darkness, Fear.

NPC-380.tactics: In public, she has the party arrested rather than fight. Unmasked, she drops the powder: her eyes show the eclipse-ring, and she becomes Eclipse-Touched [CRE-540] in all but name.

NPC-395.name: Brakka Twice-Born

traits.name: Headfirst Charge
traits.text: If Brakka moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and hits it, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition if Large or smaller.

traits.name: Second Shadow
traits.text: Once per combat, Brakka's mismatched shadow acts on its own: it makes one Axe attack against a random creature within 5 feet of her, friend or foe.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Brakka makes two Axe attacks, or one Axe attack and one Axe-gun shot.

actions.name: Axe
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Axe-gun Shot
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 40/120 ft. Hit: 12 (2d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Rage (3/Day)
bonus.text: Brakka rages for 1 minute: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, and +2 damage with her Axe.

NPC-395.tactics: Loud and generous until the bout starts, then frighteningly calm. Fights her own shadow as much as the enemy: sometimes it fights back.

NPC-401.name: Major Halloway Stroud

traits.name: Firearms Expert
traits.text: Stroud ignores the Loading property of firearms, and his firearm attacks don't have Disadvantage within 5 feet of an enemy.

traits.name: Regiment
traits.text: Stroud travels with 2d4 giff of the Twelfth Regiment (use Giff Shock Trooper from Spelljammer, or Veteran).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Stroud makes three attacks, using Pistol, Musket or Sabre in any combination.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Musket
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 40/120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d12 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sabre
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Volley!
bonus.text: Each member of the Regiment within 60 feet that can hear Stroud makes one ranged attack as a Reaction.

NPC-401.gear: Red coat, two pistols, a musket, a regiment
NPC-401.tactics: Forms a line, fires by volley, and never retreats without orders, which he gives himself. Accepts honourable surrender, and expects the same.

NPC-407.name: Duel-Marshal Durro Oruun

traits.name: Fortune of the Many
traits.text: Once per turn, when Durro misses, he gains +1 to the roll for each ally he can see within 30 feet (max +5).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Durro makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition if it's Medium or smaller.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: Trigger: Durro is hit by a melee attack. Response: He adds 3 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

NPC-407.gear: Splint armour, longsword, shield, the ledger
NPC-407.tactics: Fights by the rules of the ring, and stops the moment a challenger yields. Fights dirty only against the dead.

NPC-425.name: Iron Wim

traits.name: One of the Dead
traits.text: Wim counts as Undead as well as a Humanoid for spells and effects that target either. Turn Undead affects him.

traits.name: The Dead Stay Down for Him
traits.text: A Forgotten Legionnaire Wim hits doesn't use Won't Stay Down.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Wim makes two Shovel attacks.

actions.name: Shovel
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

NPC-425.tactics: Fights to protect the living from the Scar's dead, and won't strike a dead soldier who has stopped moving. If someone says what he is, he stops for a whole round, confused.
